positions.name: OwnedVersusRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: Where does the value of an organization's intelligence sit when the underlying substrate can be swapped out: in what the organization owns, or in what it rents?
positions.why: Both statements read the same directional question. src-2 sets owned intelligence against rented intelligence as a contrast. src-3 says the substrate is a commodity and the perspective is the asset the reader keeps, which places the value in the perspective and not the substrate. The memo argues the point rather than settling it, so this is a claim-level group with no tension inside it.
